name: What types of hardware and accessories are best for an accessible closet?

mainEntity.name: What types of hardware and accessories are best for an accessible closet?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an accessible closet, look for hardware and accessories that enhance ease of use and safety. Pull-down hanging rods are excellent for accessing items at various heights. Adjustable shelving systems allow for flexible storage configurations. D-pulls or lever handles are easier to grasp than traditional knobs. Motion-sensor lighting improves visibility without needing to flip a switch. Other useful additions include pull-out baskets, drawers with full extension slides, and sturdy grab bars for support if needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best hardware includes pull-down rods, adjustable shelving, D-pull handles, motion-sensor lighting, pull-out baskets, and full-extension drawers for improved accessibility and safety.
